newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia skilled vacancies down in April.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia skilled vacancies down in April.

text.p: The Australian government's skilled vacancies index fell 0.7 percent in April from March and was down 1.3 percent from April 1996, the Employment Department said on Thursday.
The decrease in April, to 148, was a reversal of the upward trend that was evident in the past few months.
Skilled vacancies decreased in eight of the 16 occupational groups, led by a 7.8 percent fall in the engineering and building associates and technicians sector.
The electrical and electronics trades sector dropped 7.7 percent, while the metal trades sector fell 5.6 percent.

Vacancies rose in six groups, with the largest gain recorded in vacancies for health diagnosis and treatment practitioners, up 5.4 percent. Vacancies for other professionals rose 3.4 percent and building trades gained 3.3 percent.
The index was 124.2 percent above the recession low of 66 recorded in mid-1991.
The index measures skilled vacancy advertisements in the major city newspapers on the first Saturday of each month.
